sectors.name: AI Memory
sectors.note: The week's trade. SNDK +11.9%, SKHY +8.1%, DRAM +6.6%, MU +6.1% as the memory rotation resumed on AI demand and retreating yields. SanDisk joins the S&P 100 at the 9/21 open. This is the cheapest cluster on your board — MU 6.3x forward, SNDK 7.0x — which is why the tape moves this violently on demand headlines.

sectors.name: AI Infra
sectors.note: Interconnect and boxes led: MRVL +7.0%, COHR +6.6%, SMCI +4.5% on the Cisco rack-scale partnership. Laggards were the networking-adjacent names — NET -2.0%, HPE -4.5%. Capex commentary from TSMC (raising tool estimates to 1.9x December projections) is the sector's tell.

sectors.name: AI
sectors.note: Split tape, not a selloff. NVDA +0.8% held after the $12.9B Hugging Face acquisition; CRWV +5.7% and AMD +4.7% led. The software end paid for it — SNOW -5.4%, ADBE -6.7%. Money is rotating from AI-adjacent SaaS multiples into silicon.

sectors.name: Semiconductor
sectors.note: SMH +2.6%, SOXL +9.9% on the leveraged read. Overhang is policy: South Korea chip investment talks with the US are live amid tariff concerns.

sectors.name: Space
sectors.note: Broadly firm and idiosyncratic — VOYG +3.9%, FLY +2.9%, SPCE +2.7%, with SPCX and PL each about -1.2%. No sector-level catalyst; these are still single-name stories.

sectors.name: Quantum
sectors.note: Flat as a group. ARQQ +3.6% and IONQ +1.3% against XNDU -3.0%. IONQ's record Q2 (revenue $80.1M, +287% YoY) is the only hard fundamental print in the group.

sectors.name: Crypto
sectors.note: Miners diverged from the coin complex: HUT +6.2%, RIOT +3.1% while COIN -4.2% and MARA -2.5%. Nothing sector-wide; watch the miners' power and hosting deals rather than the tape.

sectors.name: Robotics / Physical AI
sectors.note: Dragged entirely by TSLA -5.9%. OUST +1.7% and MDA +1.6% were fine. The Cybercab regulatory probe is a Tesla problem, not a robotics problem, so far.

sectors.name: Software
sectors.note: IGV -2.2%. High-multiple software is where the week's damage concentrated — NET at 193x forward and DDOG at 85x both took mid-single-digit hits.

Realized dispersion is the story: AI Memory +8.2% average against Software -1.3% on the same day. Index vol understates what individual names are doing.
Known dated events: SNDK enters the S&P 100 at the 9/21 open (index-add flow). QCOM management meets with Benchmark Sep 10.
Open regulatory item: the federal safety probe into Tesla's Cybercab is unresolved and is the live headline risk in that name.
